22:70: The Almighty informs us about the perfection of His knowledge of His creation, and that He encompasses what is in the heavens and what is on the earth, so that not even the weight of an atom on earth or in heaven escapes Him, nor anything smaller or larger than that, and that the Almighty knew all beings before they came into existence, and He wrote that in His book, the Preserved Tablet, as was proven in Sahih Muslim on the authority of Abdullah bin Amr, who said: The Messenger of God, may God bless him and grant him peace, said: God determined the measures of creation fifty thousand years before He created the heavens and the earth, and His Throne was over the water. And in the Sunan, from the hadith of a group of the Companions, that the Messenger of God, may God bless him and grant him peace, said: “The first thing that God created was the pen. He said to it: Write. It said: What should I write? It said: Write what will be. So the pen wrote what will be until the Day of Resurrection.” Ibn Abi Hatim said: Abu Zur’ah told us, Ibn Bakir told us, Ata bin Dinar told me, Saeed bin Jubair told me, he said: Ibn Abbas said: God created the Preserved Tablet as a hundred years’ journey, and He said to the pen before He created creation, which is On the Throne, Blessed and Exalted be He: Write. The Pen said: What should I write? He said: My knowledge of My creation until the Day of Resurrection. So the Pen wrote down what would be in the knowledge of God until the Day of Resurrection. This is what He said to the Prophet, may God bless him and grant him peace: Do you not know that God knows what is in the heaven and the earth? This is from the perfection of His knowledge, the Most High, that He knew things before they came into being, and He measured them and wrote them down as well. So whatever the servants would do, He, the Most High, knew before that in the way they would do it. So He knows before creation that this one obeys by his choice, and that one disobeys by his choice, and He wrote that down with Him and encompasses everything in knowledge, and it is easy for Him and simple for Him. For this reason, the Most High said: “Indeed, that is in a Record. Indeed, that, for God, is easy.”
22:71: God Almighty says, informing about the polytheists in what they were ignorant of, disbelieved, and worshipped besides God that for which He has not sent down authority, meaning proof and evidence, like His saying: “And whoever invokes with God another god for which he has no proof, then his account is only with his Lord. Indeed, the disbelievers will not succeed.” That is why He said here: that for which He has not sent down authority and of which they have no knowledge. That is, they have no knowledge of what they have fabricated and fabricated, but rather it is a matter they received from their fathers and ancestors without evidence or proof, and its origin is from what Satan tempted them and made attractive to them. That is why God Almighty threatened them with His saying: And for the wrongdoers there is no helper. That is, no helper who will support them from God in what befalls them of torment and punishment. Then He said: And when Our verses are recited to them as clear proofs. That is, when the verses of the Qur’an and the clear proofs and evidence of the oneness of God are mentioned to them, and that there is no god but Him, and that His noble messengers are true and honest. They almost assault those who recite to them. Our verses” meaning they almost rush those who argue with them with the correct evidence from the Qur’an, and they stretch out their hands and tongues to them with evil. Say meaning O Muhammad to these people, Then shall I inform you of something worse than that? The Fire which God has promised to those who disbelieve meaning the Fire and its punishment and chastisement are more severe, more difficult, more devastating and greater than what you frighten the believing friends of God with in this world, and the punishment of the Hereafter for this action of yours is greater than what you will receive from them if you receive it according to your claim and will. And His statement, And evil is the destination meaning and evil is the Fire as a resting place, a home, a return, a refuge and a place of residence. Indeed, it is an evil settlement and a place of residence.

22:73: God the Almighty says, warning against the insignificance of idols and the foolishness of the minds of those who worship them: O mankind, an example has been made meaning of what the ignorant worship of God and the polytheists, so listen to it meaning pay attention and understand Indeed, those you call upon besides God will never create a fly, even if they banded together for that purpose meaning if all the idols and rivals that you worship banded together to be able to create a single fly, they would not be able to do so. As Imam Ahmad said: Aswad bin Amir told us, Sharik told us, on the authority of Ammarah bin Al-Qa’qa’, on the authority of Abu Zur’ah, on the authority of Abu Hurairah, with a chain of transmission traceable to the Prophet, who said: And who is more unjust than he who tries to create like My creation? So let them create like My creation an atom, a fly, or a grain. The two authors of Sahih narrated it on the authority of Ammarah on the authority of Abu Zur’ah on the authority of Abu Hurayrah, on the authority of the Prophet, may God bless him and grant him peace, who said: “God Almighty said: ‘And who is more unjust than he who tries to create like My creation?’ Say: ‘Create an atom.’ So let them create a barley grain.” Then God Almighty also said: And if a fly should steal something from them, they could not rescue it from it. That is, they are unable to create a single fly, rather, they are even more incapable of resisting it or winning victory over it if it steals something of the goodness that it has, and then it wants to rescue it from it, it would not be able to do so. The fly is one of the weakest and most insignificant of God’s creations, and for this reason He said: The seeker and the sought are weak. Ibn Abbas said: The seeker is the idol, and the sought is the fly, and Ibn Jarir chose this, and it is apparent from the context. Al-Suddi and others said: The seeker is the worshipper, and the sought is the idol. Then he said: They did not appreciate God with His true appreciation meaning they did not know the power and greatness of God when they worshipped something else with Him, such as this which cannot resist a fly due to its weakness and inability. Indeed, God is Strong and Exalted in Might meaning He is the Strong, by whose power and strength He created everything. And it is He who begins creation and then repeats it, and that is easier for Him “Indeed, the wrath of your Lord is severe. Indeed, it is He who begins and repeats” Indeed, God is the Provider, the Possessor of strength, the Sturdy. And His saying: Exalted in Might means He has exalted everything, so He has subdued and overcome it, so it cannot be resisted or overcome due to His greatness and power, and He is the One, the Subduer.

22:75: The Almighty informs us that He chooses messengers from among the angels in whatever He wishes of His law and decree, and from among the people to convey His message, Indeed, God is All-Hearing, All-Seeing, meaning He hears the words of His servants, sees them, and knows who among them deserves that, as He said, God knows best where to place His message, and His statement, He knows what is before them and what is behind them, and to God all matters are returned, meaning He knows what His messengers do in what He sent them with, so nothing of their affairs is hidden from Him, as He said, “He is the Knower of the unseen, and He reveals His unseen to none * Except to a messenger whom He has approved. Then He makes watchers march before him and behind him * That He may know that they have conveyed the messages of their Lord. And He encompasses what is with them and has taken account of all things in number.” So He, glory be to Him, is a watcher over them, a witness to what they say, a protector of them, a supporter of their side, “O Messenger, deliver what has been revealed to you from your Lord. And if you do not, then you have not delivered His message. And God will protect you from the people.” The verse.
